thread:
maria: quick sync 10min1 about regression-diff list UX. users with long runs find rows noisy. thinking: add a Compact/Comfortable toggle + soften row separators.

sam: +1. banding or soft tints help scanning. please avoid heavy borders.

devin: compact toggle should be persisted per user and get a keyboard shortcut (toggle: Shift+D?). track metric density_toggle_used.

alex: few a11y nits: 1) 'Accepted' badge contrast is low on our card bg, needs darker fill or outline. 2) tiny touch targets in right rail heatmap -> make >=44px. 3) focus must move into details panel when opened.

maria: noted. also for 1-2 token diffs the yellow highlight looks like dots; proposal: render 2-word context and a "Show full diff" action to reduce clutter.

sam: keyboard: focus ring looks same as hover right now. propose distinct 3px outline + visible z-index.

devin: copy tweak: bulk CTA -> "Approve selected revisions" and button shows count. undo toast: "Approved Undo (5s)" with accessible aria-live announcement.

aria-bot: ticket UX-799 created: "regression list density & a11y" assigned @maria, labels: design, accessibility.

maria: I'll post Figma mocks (banding, compact toggle, CTA copy) in 2 hrs. ping me if you want to pair on the prototype. :thumbsup:
